quarterly_data.quarter: Volex press release: Preliminary Group Results for the Year Ended 31 March 2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (year ended March 31, 2026): revenue $1,242.6 million, up 14.4% (organic 14.2%), led by strong Data Centre demand; underlying operating profit $127.3 million, up 19.9%; underlying operating margin 10.2%, above the previous 9-10% target range for the first time; underlying gross margin 23.2%, up 180 basis points on a higher weighting of high-value Data Centre products. Complex Industrial Technology grew 56.3% organically to $382.9 million, including strong Data Centre demand from a leading hyperscale customer; Data Centre revenues approximately doubled and now account for 63.0% of that end-market's revenue (FY2025: 48.3%). North America grew 28.2% to $645.5 million, led by Data Centre and defence; Asia fell 7.3% to $158.0m as hyperscale customers directed more demand through North America-managed relationships.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue $1,242.6 million (+14.4%); Data Centre 63.0% of Complex Industrial Technology revenue ($382.9 million, +56.3% organic)

quarterly_data.quarter: Volex press release: Preliminary Group Results for the Year Ended 31 March 2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term targets set at the April 22, 2026 Capital Markets Day: Group revenue of $2 billion, underlying operating margin of 12% and return on capital employed of around 20%, built bottom-up including programmes already won. Outlook: trading to date in FY2027 has been strong and in line with the Board's expectations; demand across key end-markets is robust with good forward visibility from the order book, and continued strength in Data Centre, Off-Highway and EV & Electrification underpins confidence in year-on-year progress. CEO Nat Rothschild: 'We enter FY2027 with strong momentum, a more capable platform and a clear pathway towards our medium term targets.'
quarterly_data.figure: Medium-term targets: revenue $2 billion, underlying operating margin 12%, ROCE around 20%

quarterly_data.quarter: Volex press release: Preliminary Group Results for the Year Ended 31 March 2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data-centre capability and capacity: Volex's high-speed data cable capabilities now reach 1.6 terabit-per-second, the output of expanded R&D focused on Data Centres and EV & Electrification; ongoing certification across successive cable technology generations makes each product step more technically demanding and higher-value. FY2026 capital investment of $34.8 million (2.8% of revenue) focused on capacity at sites supporting Data Centre and EV & Electrification customers, including a completed Mexico expansion ($6 million at San Luis Potosi). Through proactive supply chain management Volex handled a significant ramp-up in output; inventory investment to support accelerated Data Centre demand (a hub model with a longer cash cycle) caused a $67.9 million cash outflow.
quarterly_data.figure: Data cables up to 1.6 terabit-per-second; capex $34.8 million; Data Centre inventory outflow $67.9 million
